name: lexbound
description: Lexbound: an offline creature-companion RPG set in Lexora, where the Lexlings speak Italian.

scripts.test: npm run test -w @lexbound/core && npm run test -w @lexbound/content
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @lexbound/core && npm run typecheck -w @lexbound/content && npm run typecheck -w @lexbound/app
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run lint:copy && npm test && npm run sfx -- --check
